changes.comment: Fix cross-subspace "workspace:*" dependencies failing with ERR_PNPM_WORKSPACE_PKG_NOT_FOUND under pnpm 11 when subspaces are enabled. The subspace "global pnpmfile" was wired up via a "global-pnpmfile=" line in the generated .npmrc, but pnpm 11 only reads auth/registry settings from .npmrc; for pnpm 11+ Rush now emits the path via the "globalPnpmfile" setting of the generated pnpm-workspace.yaml. Behavior for pnpm 10 and earlier is unchanged.
